verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a GrowthBook Proxy that runs next to your app, caches SDK payloads and keeps serving flags if the API is down [growthbook-docs-11], with security and real-time rollouts [growthbook-docs-45]. Self-hosting with Docker Compose [growthbook-docs-10] plus local SDK evaluation of a cacheable JSON definition [growthbook-comm-6] lets SDK traffic stay inside your network. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the proxy's offline resilience, and detailed docs on deploying and routing the proxy for in-network-only SDK traffic.
